components.name: Compiler frontend prototype
components.rationale: The frontend accepts only the documented FACT, VARIAT and COMBIN assignments followed by PRINT; it is not a general GFA BASIC parser.

components.name: Typed project IR
components.rationale: Typed IR construction and verification exist for the narrow prototype; the general semantic and lowering contract is not implemented.

components.name: General language semantics
components.rationale: Version-specific language rules remain evidence-gated; research and candidate corpus entries are not implementation.

components.name: Compiler CLI
components.rationale: Help, version, the subset formatter and the narrow prototype build command exist; project loading, general checking and production compilation do not.

components.name: Source formatter
components.rationale: Formatting is implemented only for syntax accepted by the current frontend; unsupported constructs are rejected.

components.name: Language server
components.rationale: The dependency-free LSP adapter supports document lifecycle and shared-frontend diagnostics; formatting, navigation, completion and rename are not implemented.

components.name: LLVM backend
components.rationale: LLVM is the intended production backend; no LLVM backend implementation or binding is selected.

components.name: Generated-program runtime
components.rationale: The runtime crate establishes an architectural placeholder; generated-program runtime behavior and a stable runtime ABI are not implemented.

components.name: Linux platform adapter
components.rationale: The platform crate defines the intended adapter boundary; Linux services and SDL3 integration are not implemented.

components.name: Testing and dialect conformance
components.rationale: Unit and prototype smoke tests plus a metadata-validated evidence corpus exist; no general corpus runner or full dialect conformance suite exists.

components.name: Release and supply-chain tooling
components.rationale: PR SBOM validation and a release-event SBOM attachment workflow exist; compiler packaging and a complete release workflow do not.
